current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Recognizes Right to be Free from Climate Change Impacts
current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court expanded the scope of Article 21 (Right to Life) and Article 14 (Right to Equality) to include the fundamental right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change, while balancing biodiversity conservation of the Great Indian Bustard with renewable energy expansion.

current_affairs.title: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA)
current_affairs.summary: India signed a historic trade deal with the European Free Trade Association (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland), securing a commitment of $100 billion in investments over 15 years and generation of 1 million direct jobs.

current_affairs.title: RBI Transfer of Record Dividend Surplus to the Central Government
current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record surplus transfer of ₹2.11 lakh crore to the Central Government for FY24 under the Economic Capital Framework (ECF), aiding fiscal deficit targets and capital expenditure plans.

current_affairs.title: Induction of INS Jatayu at Minicoy Island
current_affairs.summary: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Jatayu at Minicoy Island in Lakshadweep, significantly strengthening maritime domain awareness, operational reach, and anti-piracy operations in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).

current_affairs.title: Plastic Waste Management (Amendment) Rules, 2024
current_affairs.summary: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change notified new rules defining biodegradable plastics, enforcing stricter criteria for microplastics threshold, and introducing mandatory certification by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
